long_biography.plain_text:
Mehmet Oğuz Çarmıklı helped endow the Nurol Education, Culture and Sports Foundation with cash and property. Established by his family in 1996, it provides scholarships for successful students with limited means. Its work has included building schools, libraries and sports facilities and donating them, fully furnished, to Turkey’s Ministry of National Education.

Çarmıklı trained in civil engineering at Istanbul’s Yıldız engineering school. His corporate responsibilities include a longstanding position as vice chairman of Nurol Investment Bank, which he has held since 1999. He also serves on the bank’s remuneration committee.
